chapters.title: Estonia Closes Border Crossings With Russia
Andy Burnham Declares Brexit Has Not
Void Opinion
chapters.subtitle: Markets do not respond to nostalgia. Prime Minister Andy Burnham stands at Mansion House on November 16, 2026, to declare that leaving the European Union has not worked. He prepares for a Brussels summit scheduled for November 20 with three distinct tests for a new accord. These criteria demand that any arrangement improve upon the existing Brexit deal, satisfy a Makerfield test for everyday life, and respect strict manifesto red lines. Those red lines forbid any return to the single market, the customs union, or the free movement of people.
